preciseTargeting.title: Precise targeting
preciseTargeting.description: Cluega AI interprets spoken conversations perfectly and automatically turns your ideas into the most precise audience targeting and budget allocation across every platform.

crossPlatform.title: Seamless cross-platform integration
crossPlatform.description: Say goodbye to fragmented dashboards! Cluega automatically connects every channel and manages all campaigns and review statuses in one place.

intuitiveEdits.title: Intuitive edits, second-level sync
intuitiveEdits.description: This is more than a data dashboard. Toggle ads and adjust budgets directly in a unified table, with changes synced to every media platform in real time.

integration.title: Real-time sync, zero-friction setup.
integration.description: Cluega connects directly to your official Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Google Ads marketing accounts.

connect.title: Account Intelligence — starts the moment you authorize
connect.description: Whenever you connect an ad account, Cluega automatically analyzes its full history in the background — from conversion volume and cost trends to creative performance and audience saturation. No tedious setup required: once authorization is complete, deep analysis starts running immediately.

tiktok.description: Run and track TikTok ad performance

google.name: Google Ads
google.description: Google Search and Display Network campaigns

maturity.title: Account Maturity Stages (M0–M5) — master the account lifecycle precisely
maturity.description: Not every account should be run with the same strategy. An account that just launched and one that has been running for two years need completely different strategies. Cluega automatically classifies accounts into six maturity stages, M0–M5 (from cold start to the flywheel phase), filtering out the noise at each stage so it only analyzes the truly critical core metrics for you.

grading.title: Ad Set Grading (S / A / B / C / D) — instantly know which ad set is worth backing
grading.description: Cluega evaluates both data credibility and performance momentum to score every ad set precisely. From S tier (rising star, add budget in one click) to D tier (pause candidate), it helps you put spend where it matters most.

mcpReady.title: AI-managed delivery decisions
mcpReady.description: Cluega is an ad platform built for AI agents, turning ad analysis into executable instructions in an instant. Turn on managed mode for precise execution with no second round of reasoning.

burstDetection.title: Never miss a new account's surge
burstDetection.description: If a new account bursts into conversions within 24 hours, Cluega instantly starts a 72-hour observation mode: locking budget to avoid misjudgment while monitoring continuously, and the moment it qualifies, promoting it to a "rising star" and notifying you.

fatigueIntelligence.title: Early warning for aging accounts
fatigueIntelligence.description: Cluega recalculates each ad set's momentum score daily and keeps tracking decline signals. The moment a rating drops to Tier C (decline warning), the system proactively diagnoses the cause and gives concrete optimization directions.

alwaysCurrent.title: Auto-updated every day
alwaysCurrent.description: An ad account's state changes every day. Cluega recalculates the tiering of every account in the early hours each day, so that when your AI or optimizer makes delivery decisions, they always hold the latest, up-to-the-moment status.

finalCta.heading: Say goodbye to tedious multi-platform setup — drive high-performance delivery with a single command.

header.title: Management without effort.
header.description: Every detail after your ads start running stays fully under your control.

planMonitoring.title: Real-time ad plan monitoring
planMonitoring.description: A global view built for cross-platform custody. The real-time status and review progress of every plan are clear at a glance, with no need to switch platforms.

accountDashboard.title: Cross-platform account integration and real-time data dashboard
accountDashboard.description: Switch across your cross-platform promotion accounts from a single entry point at any time, call up core funnel data in real time, and keep the most valuable growth metrics under control.

manualAdjustments.title: Manual adjustments from an intuitive panel
manualAdjustments.description: Control down to the ad group level. You can pause ads with a one-click toggle at any time, manually edit bids and budgets, and sync changes to major media platforms within milliseconds.

autoDiagnosis.title: The human–AI campaign command center
autoDiagnosis.description: Bring AI actions, team operations, and media data onto a single timeline. Whether GPT adjusts budgets, Claude generates optimization suggestions, or a teammate bids manually, every record is fully tracked — so anyone who takes over instantly grasps the whole picture.

management.quote: With a single integrated interface, I can not only track ad progress across every platform at any time, but also make manual adjustments directly. This has improved delivery efficiency by more than tenfold!

quote.title: Advertising workflow testimonial
quote.content: Cluega AI completely transformed our campaign workflow. We used to manually adjust bids and swap creatives across three ad dashboards every day. Now AI optimizes everything automatically and saves us 80% of our work time!

multiPlatform.title: One-click cross-platform deployment
multiPlatform.body: Connect TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and more. With one command, automatically sync ECO-TM-500ML product assets and specs to generate multi-platform ads — the algorithm takes over bidding.

reviewAssist.title: Intelligent review assistance
reviewAssist.body: AI automatically pre-checks product hero images and detail page compliance, avoids common e-commerce rejection keywords, shortens average review time by 60%, and speeds up approval.

budgetSchedule.title: Data hits target, AI fully takes over
budgetSchedule.body: Once the account data reaches your set goals, activate managed mode—Cluega takes over ad decisions. Increase budget, pause ad groups, rotate creatives—AI executes directly. You set the boundaries, and AI operates autonomously within those boundaries.

unifiedAcquisition.title: Unified one-click user acquisition
unifiedAcquisition.body: Supports app acquisition and re-engagement. One-click sync for download and Deep Linking setup.

reviewOptimization.title: Review optimization
reviewOptimization.body: Pre-checks Deep Linking compliance paths to prevent app takedowns when App Store / Google Play policies change.

eventValueCustody.title: Two-way event and value custody
eventValueCustody.body: AEO (event optimization) / VO (value optimization) dual custody lets the algorithm target high-value whale users with large top-ups and high-weight subscriptions.

dmAds.title: Private-message ads
dmAds.body: Build high-trust one-on-one interactions instantly. Whether through in-platform DMs or handoff to WhatsApp and other messaging tools, sales teams can offer warm, real-time consultation, resolve purchase doubts flexibly, and retain customers as private-domain traffic for long-term remarketing.

formAds.title: Form ads
formAds.body: A minimal, high-efficiency conversion flow. After a tap, a pre-filled form opens in-app — no webpage redirect drop-off. Basic info is auto-filled to remove manual entry, attracting willing leads with low friction. Ideal for standardized products or industries that follow up by phone.
